WITH pub_hoje AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_hoje
  FROM publicacoes
  WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
    AND status IN ('agendado', 'publicado')
),
nichos_com_clips AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(cg.nicho), '') AS nicho
  FROM clips_gerados cg
  WHERE cg.status_publicacao = 'pronto_para_publicar'
    AND cg.status = 'pronto_para_publicar'
    AND cg.vizard_video_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(cg.nicho), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM publicacoes p
      WHERE p.clip_id = cg.id AND p.status IN ('agendado', 'publicado')
    )
),
nicho_ranking AS (
  SELECT
    nc.nicho,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM publicacoes p2
      JOIN clips_gerados cg2 ON cg2.id = p2.clip_id
      WHERE cg2.nicho = nc.nicho
        AND p2.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
        AND p2.status IN ('agendado', 'publicado')
    ), 0) AS pub_hoje_nicho
  FROM nichos_com_clips nc
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT nicho FROM nicho_ranking ORDER BY pub_hoje_nicho ASC, RANDOM() LIMIT 1), 'fila_sem_nicho') AS nicho,
  (SELECT total_hoje FROM pub_hoje) AS ready_count;

WITH pub_hoje AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM publicacoes
  WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
    AND status IN ('agendado', 'publicado')
)
SELECT
  cg.id AS clip_id,
  cg.vizard_video_id,
  cg.titulo_final,
  cg.descricao_final,
  cg.descricao_base,
  cg.hashtags,
  cg.nicho,
  cg.canal_id,
  cg.score_clip,
  cg.arquivo_clip_url,
  cd.nome_canal
FROM clips_gerados cg
LEFT JOIN canais_descobertos cd ON cd.canal_id = cg.canal_id
CROSS JOIN pub_hoje ph
WHERE cg.status_publicacao = 'pronto_para_publicar'
  AND cg.status = 'pronto_para_publicar'
  AND cg.vizard_video_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ph.total < 6
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM publicacoes p
    WHERE p.clip_id = cg.id
      AND p.status IN ('agendado', 'publicado')
  )
ORDER BY cg.score_clip DESC NULLS LAST, cg.created_at ASC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE clips_gerados
SET status = 'em_processamento',
    status_publicacao = 'em_processamento',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.clip_id }}'
  AND status_publicacao = 'pronto_para_publicar'
RETURNING id;

UPDATE clips_gerados
SET status = 'erro',
    status_publicacao = 'erro',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('fetch-clip-do-nicho').item.json.clip_id }}';

SELECT id FROM publicacoes
WHERE clip_id = '{{ $json.clip_id }}'
  AND plataforma = '{{ $json.account_platform }}'
  AND status IN ('publicado', 'agendado')
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO publicacoes (
  clip_id,
  plataforma,
  id_publicacao_plataforma,
  status,
  erro_mensagem,
  data_publicacao,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.clip_id }}',
  '{{ $json.account_platform }}',
  {{ $json.pub_platform_id ? "'" + String($json.pub_platform_id).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }},
  '{{ $json.pub_status }}',
  {{ $json.publish_error ? "'" + String($json.publish_error).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.pub_status === 'agendado' ? "to_timestamp(" + $json.publish_time + ")" : ($json.pub_status === 'publicado' ? "NOW()" : "NULL") }},
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_publicacao_plataforma DO UPDATE
SET status = EXCLUDED.status,
    erro_mensagem = EXCLUDED.erro_mensagem,
    data_publicacao = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.data_publicacao, publicacoes.data_publicacao),
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, status, '{{ $json.clip_id }}' AS clip_id, {{ $json.success }} AS success;

UPDATE clips_gerados cg
SET status = CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM publicacoes p
        WHERE p.clip_id = cg.id AND p.status = 'publicado'
      ) THEN 'publicado'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM publicacoes p
        WHERE p.clip_id = cg.id AND p.status = 'agendado'
      ) THEN 'agendado'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM publicacoes p
        WHERE p.clip_id = cg.id AND p.status = 'erro'
      ) THEN 'erro'
      ELSE cg.status
    END,
    status_publicacao = CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM publicacoes p
        WHERE p.clip_id = cg.id AND p.status = 'publicado'
      ) THEN 'publicado'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM publicacoes p
        WHERE p.clip_id = cg.id AND p.status = 'agendado'
      ) THEN 'agendado'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM publicacoes p
        WHERE p.clip_id = cg.id AND p.status = 'erro'
      ) THEN 'erro'
      ELSE cg.status_publicacao
    END,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE cg.id = '{{ $('fetch-clip-do-nicho').item.json.clip_id }}'
RETURNING id, status, status_publicacao;
